en-US.title: Tenfold: Batch Video Editor
en-US.subtitle: Cut pauses, add captions, x10
en-US.description:
Film ten takes. Post ten videos.

Tenfold edits talking-to-camera clips on your iPhone, ten at a time. Import a batch from Photos or record in the app, choose what Tenfold should do, and generate finished videos ready to post.

WHAT IT DOES
• Removes pauses, filler words ("um", "uh", "like") and repeated takes
• Word-by-word captions in 12 styles, synced to your voice
• Reframes for vertical: 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9, with a subtle zoom at each cut
• Batches of up to 10 clips at once, each with its own on/off edits

A REAL EDITOR WHEN YOU WANT ONE
• Tap any caption to fix a word, split, merge, hide or retime it
• Caption styles with background, outline, shadow and your own colours
• Titles and hooks with a TikTok-style text tool: nine styles, drag, pinch and rotate
• Audio: split or silence the original sound, add music from Files, extract sound from another video, record a voiceover, automatic ducking under speech
• Join several clips into one video, reorder, trim, split and delete
• Undo, redo and revert to the original at any time

ON YOUR PHONE
Everything runs on the iPhone with Apple's on-device speech recognition. No account, no upload, no waiting for a server. Your footage never leaves the phone.

FREE AND PAID
The free plan includes batches of 10 and 3 exports a month. Starter, Pro and Studio subscriptions add more exports, bigger batches, every caption style, no watermark and 4K export. Pro and Studio start with a 3-day free trial; Starter has no trial. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Terms: https://ibrahim1774.github.io/tenfold/terms.html
Privacy: https://ibrahim1774.github.io/tenfold/privacy.html

review.notes:
Tenfold has no accounts and no server for video processing. Everything runs on the device with Apple's on-device speech recognition (iOS 26). Videos, audio and transcripts never leave the device.

To test: open the app, finish onboarding, tap Import clips and pick one or more videos with speech from Photos, choose the edits to apply, then Generate. Open a finished video to reach the editor: Captions, Text, Audio and the + tile for adding clips. Export saves to Photos.

Subscriptions (sold through the App Store, presented with the Superwall SDK): Starter (monthly and yearly, no free trial), Pro and Studio (monthly and yearly, each with a 3-day free trial). The free plan works without any purchase (3 exports a month, batches of 10).

App Tracking Transparency: the tracking prompt appears on the first onboarding tap. Tracking is only used by AppsFlyer for ad attribution; the app works the same if tracking is declined. Anonymous usage analytics (PostHog) are not used for tracking.

Permissions are requested only when used: camera and microphone for in-app recording, add-to-Photos for export, speech recognition for captions.
